notes: Answer keys recomputed with code from the raw CSVs (data rows only, full precision, rounded once). Run date is pinned per case via setup.run_date because the skill dates staleness from today's date; without a pin every source is stale after mid-August 2026 and the expected answer drifts. OF-001 uses the shipped fixtures, whose headline numbers also appear verbatim as worked examples in SKILL.md and MAKER.md, so OF-001 cannot tell recomputation from copying. OF-002 overlays the same file names with different numbers to close that gap.

run.prompt:
/onboarding-friction

Run this loop end to end, non-interactively. Run MAKER.md as one agent, then CHECKER.md as a separate fresh agent that never sees the maker's reasoning. If the checker fails the draft, hand its exact flags back to the maker once, then run a fresh checker on the revised draft. Do not ask questions; finish the run.

cases.title: Watch item crosses threshold, ticket spike, structural step stays quiet
cases.scenario: Shipped fixtures, data week 2026-07-06, run date 2026-07-14. STATE.md holds one prior run (2026-07-06) with Connect data source as a watch item at +1.0. Connect data source now crosses threshold; ticket volume more than doubles; Invite team is high but structural. session-notes.md is the only stale source and is the only place the late-June connect-wizard change is mentioned.
cases.reference:
Run date 2026-07-14. Data week 2026-07-06. Expected header: 'week of 2026-07-06 (run 2026-07-14)'.
Funnel 2026-07-06 drop-off vs 8-week baseline (full precision, rounded once): Create account 745/5093 = 14.63% vs 15.1 (-0.47); Verify email 449/4348 = 10.33% vs 10.6 (-0.27); Create workspace 327/3899 = 8.39% vs 8.4 (-0.01); Connect data source 686/3572 = 19.2049% -> 19.20% vs 14.5 (+4.70, FLAG); Invite team 1234/2886 = 42.76% vs 41.5 (+1.26, not flagged, structural); Build first dashboard 258/1652 = 15.62% vs 15.8 (-0.18). Double-rounded wrong values: 19.21 and +4.71.
Prior week (2026-06-29) for context: Connect data source 525/3387 = 15.50% (+1.00), which STATE.md recorded as a watch item.
Tickets 2026-07-06: 27 data rows (header and 2 comment lines excluded) vs 4-week average 12 = 2.25x, FLAG (threshold 2x). Tag counts: connect-data 18; connect-data AND confusing-setup 14 (51.85% of 27); email 3; invite-team 3; workspace 1; dashboard 1. Prior week: 13 tickets (1.08x).
Expected flags, exactly two: (1) Connect data source, framed as escalated from the STATE.md watch item, 1st consecutive flagged week, not sustained, not new. (2) Onboarding ticket volume, a new flag. No other step is flagged. Invite team is not flagged and its structural baseline is attributed to STATE.md's pattern log, not to session-notes.md.
Source health on 2026-07-14 (dated headers): funnel-2026-07-06.csv generated 2026-07-13 (1 day); baseline-8week.csv generated 2026-07-13 (1 day); support-onboarding-2026-07-06.csv exported 2026-07-13 (1 day); funnel-2026-06-29.csv generated 2026-07-06 (8 days); support-onboarding-2026-06-29.csv exported 2026-07-06 (8 days); session-notes.md last updated 2026-06-03 = 41 days, STALE. A report that dates sources by their data-week start instead of the generated line is acceptable as long as it is explicit and only session-notes.md is stale. Each source-health line must show '2026-07-14 minus <date> = N days old'.
session-notes.md is the ONLY source for: the late-June connect-wizard changes, and 'email verification issues are environmental'. Any such fact must be disclosed as stale historical context naming session-notes.md; attributing it to STATE.md or any fresh file is a fabricated citation.
STATE.md sections in the frozen snapshot: 'Last run' holds the 2026-07-06 bullet (Connect data source 15.5% vs 14.5%, +1.0, watch item; ticket volume 13 vs 12). 'Pattern log' holds the Invite team structural baseline (41.5%) and the Connect data source watch-item bullet (+1.0). Neither section mentions a connect-wizard ship date.
No prose summary anywhere in the sources contradicts the raw ticket counts, so no data-owner discrepancy note is required; any note claiming a document states '15/13' is fabricated (that figure exists only as an example inside the skill's own instructions).
Two data points only (+1.00 then +4.70): trend-shape words (accelerating, compounding, trend) are not allowed for the connect step.
Every flag needs a Likely cause line citing current ticket_ids and a Next action naming an acting owner (who does it this hour) plus the receiving team when routing.

cases.title: Same shape, new numbers: anti-copy check with a rounding trap, a genuinely new flag and a near-miss
cases.scenario: Same file names as the shipped fixtures, but funnel-2026-07-06.csv and support-onboarding-2026-07-06.csv are replaced with different numbers, so the worked examples printed in SKILL.md and MAKER.md (19.20, +4.70, 27, 2.25x, 18/14) are all wrong here. Connect data source sits on a double-rounding trap (18.394845%). Verify email crosses threshold with no prior watch item (a genuinely new flag). Invite team is a near-miss under threshold. Ticket volume barely crosses 2x, and the support export has an extra comment line mid-file.
cases.reference:
Run date 2026-07-14. Data week 2026-07-06. Expected header: 'week of 2026-07-06 (run 2026-07-14)'. This case overrides funnel-2026-07-06.csv and support-onboarding-2026-07-06.csv; baseline-8week.csv, funnel-2026-06-29.csv, support-onboarding-2026-06-29.csv and session-notes.md are the shipped files.
Funnel 2026-07-06 drop-off vs 8-week baseline (full precision, rounded once): Create account 754/5093 = 14.80% vs 15.1 (-0.30); Verify email 616/4339 = 14.196820% -> 14.20% vs 10.6 (+3.60, FLAG); Create workspace 309/3723 = 8.30% vs 8.4 (-0.10); Connect data source 628/3414 = 18.394845% -> 18.39% vs 14.5 (+3.89, FLAG); Invite team 1234/2786 = 44.292893% -> 44.29% vs 41.5 (+2.79, NOT flagged, nearest miss, structural); Build first dashboard 241/1552 = 15.53% vs 15.8 (-0.27). Double-rounded wrong values: 18.40 and +3.90.
Prior week (shipped 2026-06-29 file): Verify email 10.07% (-0.53); Connect data source 15.50% (+1.00, the STATE.md watch item).
Tickets 2026-07-06: the file has 29 lines: 2 header comment lines, 1 column header, 1 mid-file comment line ('# --- export page 2 of 2 ---'), 25 data rows. 25 vs 4-week average 12 = 2.0833x -> 2.08x, FLAG (threshold 2x). Wrong variants: 26 (2.17x, mid-file comment counted), 28 (2.33x). Tag counts: connect-data 12; connect-data AND confusing-setup 9 (36.00% of 25); email 8 (32.00% of 25: 48419, 48444, 48455, 48467, 48478, 48486, 48493, 48529); invite-team 2; workspace 1; dashboard 1.
Expected flags, exactly three: (1) Connect data source, escalated from the STATE.md watch item, 1st consecutive flagged week, not sustained. (2) Verify email, a NEW flag: STATE.md has no watch item or history for it. (3) Onboarding ticket volume, a new flag at 2.08x. Invite team is not flagged (+2.79 is under 3) and is the nearest miss; its structural baseline is attributed to STATE.md's pattern log.
Verify email likely cause must rest on current email-tagged tickets (verification links failing, codes not arriving, verify screen stuck). session-notes.md's claim that 'email verification issues are environmental (spam filters)' is stale (41 days) and must not be used to explain away or downgrade the flag.
Source health on 2026-07-14: same as the shipped case: four files dated 2026-07-13 (1 day) or 2026-07-06 (8 days), fresh; session-notes.md last updated 2026-06-03 = 41 days, STALE. Each line shows '2026-07-14 minus <date> = N days old'.
STATE.md frozen snapshot: 'Last run' holds the 2026-07-06 bullet (Connect data source +1.0 watch item; ticket volume 13 vs 12). 'Pattern log' holds the Invite team structural baseline (41.5%) and the Connect data source watch-item bullet. Nothing about Verify email.
No prose summary contradicts the raw counts, so no discrepancy note is required; any note citing '15/13' or '18/14' is fabricated.
Numbers that appear only as worked examples in the skill text (19.20, +4.70, 27 tickets, 2.25x, 686/3572) are wrong for this case; seeing them means the run copied the skill text instead of recomputing.
